name: STAR Frames — hour angle and declination to azimuth and elevation
summary: Azimuth and elevation from hour angle, declination and latitude, the inverse, and the parallactic angle; agrees with ERFA and a SPICE rotation to 1.1e-13 deg on 600 cases in both directions and refuses out-of-range input.
reference: Meeus, Astronomical Algorithms, Example 13.b: H = 64.352133, delta = -6.719892, phi = 38.921389 give azimuth 248.0337 (from North through East) and altitude 15.1249
reference_observed: (248.033693, 15.124874): within 2.7e-5 deg of the printed values (printed to 1e-4)

na.G-14: no performance requirement declared by any user

review.G-04: degrees in and out; azimuth from North through East, hour angle positive West; output ranges stated
review.G-06: no external data; cross-check corpus generated with a fixed seed
review.G-08: pure functions, standard library only, no IO
review.G-13: ValueError for every invalid input; undefined angles returned as 0 and documented; no iteration
